lines: 第一章：黑龙山脉
时维三月，在寒冬渐去，暖春将来的桃花汛期。大赵皇朝西南边陲，天龙郡黑龙山脉。在尽是层峦叠嶂，山岭密布，一山接着一岭，沟壑幽深的山脉之中。只见漫山烟云霏绕，尽是参树大木遍布，一片铺碧叠翠。一阵春风拂过，绿浪起伏，万木成涛，罗烟变幻，气象万千，令观者宠辱皆忘、飘然欲仙。
远远望去，这黑龙山脉像极了一条即将腾飞的巨龙。传说在万年前，一条黑色的巨龙从天而降，幻化成了这蔓延千里的黑龙山脉，这也是黑龙山脉名字的由来。
在黑龙山脉天鹰峰，一处百丈来高的低矮山丘上。只见一十来多岁的青色短衫少年，光着臂膀，腹心松静收腹溜臀的举着一块，方丈大小，百来斤的青色巨石，打熬着身体。
刚刚绽放的桃花，还挂在枝头。那青衫少年正这桃林之中，提顶吊裆空胸紧背，一板一眼的打着一套拳法。只见那百来斤的巨石，随着他招式的变动，在他的身躯之上来回移动着，石随身动，宛如一体。
那少年的动作，时而像凶狮搏兔蛟龙出海，时而又像毒蛇吐信金鸡独立。只见狮、麟、蛇、鸡、龙、凤、熊、猴八禽之形态，在其手中慢慢演变开来，其动作更是显得能进能退，能化能生，虚实结合，端是变化无穷。
只见那少年的招式速度越来越快，让人分不清哪是人，哪是青石。渐渐的，随着少年身姿的舞动，只见一团青影，带起一阵阵热风。顿时，那刚刚开花的树枝，呀呀作响，响个不停，将本不多的桃蕊，也一一摇落。
叶重抬头看来一眼，被云霞布满的天空，心中默念道：“时间到了，该回堡了，否则母亲该着急了！”。
回想起自己在突破炼筋时，忘我的修炼，以至于忘记了时间。最终母亲沈妍发动全堡的人，在天鹰峰搜寻自己，自己也被大发雷霆的母亲，惩罚关了一个月紧闭。让叶重暖心的同时，也是心有余悸。自此之后，叶重可再也不敢，不按时回堡。叶重既怕母亲担心，也怕母亲大发雷霆。
只见叶重迈着一种奇异的步伐，不过瞬息的功夫，便在了百米开外。随即只见一道青影，在山林中闪烁着，带起一道道如风般的青色残影。
看着越来越清晰的朱红大门，叶重低声嘀咕道：“这‘八步蝉’算是大成了，只是迟迟都无法形成‘元轮’，成为‘武者’，不知要等到何时？”。
叶重有一个只能自己知道的秘密，自己本不是这个世界的人。叶重前世生活在一个名叫“地球”的蔚蓝星球，是华夏古国的八卦门传人。
在叶重前世生活的世界，武学衰微，技法失传脱节。传说中的先天武者，更是早已成为绝响。
叶重本身虽在武学上堪称天纵之才，却也止步于后天之境。经过多方查阅古籍中的断章残节，前世的叶重，曾作出一个大胆的推想。
上古时代，天地灵气浓郁，武者先打磨自身，随即纳天地灵气为己用，突破人体桎梏，打破天地法规，成为陆地神仙，白日飞升。
只是到后来，天地灵气渐渐流失消散，变得非常稀薄，武者难以吸收。自通微显化真人张三丰后，再无陆地神仙，白日飞升之者。再到近代，随着文明的高度发展，人口.爆炸性的增长，天地灵气终于消散殆尽，最后连先天武者都成了绝响。
出于武者追逐武道巅峰的执念，前世的叶重，在三十岁时修为臻达后天巅峰后，千方百计地谋求，想突破到传说中的先天之境。甚至不惜加入国家部门，搜集古老修行秘籍，想借此突破。
然而事与愿违，在一次执行任务的过程中，惨遭叛徒出卖，被敌围攻，最终身死异乡魂归异世。重生到了这元武大陆，托生于一个名叫“天鹰堡”的家族。还好天见可怜，重生到了这灵气浓郁的元武大陆，可以继续追寻那缥缈无上的武道之路。
“重少爷，您回来了！”，两名身穿黑色长袍的小厮，对叶重弯腰恭敬道。
闻言，叶重笑着点了点头，随即跨步进门而去。
“沈福，重少爷他也真是刻苦啊！天天勤于修炼，只怕不日就可以成为武者了吧！”
随即只听一道肯定的声音，敬佩的答道：“那是当然，重少爷五岁习武，八岁炼体，十岁炼筋，十二岁就已经开了八脉，只要形成‘元轮’，就可以成为‘武者’了。重少爷注定是要成为皇朝风云人物的，不是你我可比的！”。
一说完，那名小厮还一脸羡慕的看着叶重远去的身影。
对面的小厮，闻言点了点头，一脸喜气的答道：“是啊！大少爷在的时候，也没见有重少爷这么刻苦。而且大少爷十三岁才开了八脉，比重少爷可是晚了整整一年呢。大少爷十五岁就能进天渊府修炼，重少爷肯定也能，我天鹰堡看样子又要风光一阵子了！”。
“我看你小子，是想着堡主的赏钱吧！你小子也是滑头，竟然用大少爷进天渊府的赏钱，结了一门亲，取了一个如花似玉的婆娘，今年还生了一个胖小子，可是羡慕死老子了！”，沈福搓了搓手，一脸笑意的答道。

Chapter 1: Black Dragon Mountains
It's March, the cold winter is gradually gone, and the warm spring is coming, the peach blossom season. On the southwest border of the Great Zhao Dynasty, in the Black Dragon Mountains of Tianlong County. In the mountains, there are many mountains and mountains, one after another, and deep ravines. I saw that the mountains were surrounded by smoke and clouds, and they were covered with large ginseng trees and green trees. A gust of spring breeze blows, the green waves rise and fall, thousands of trees become waves, the smoke changes, and the weather is endless, making the viewer forget all the favors and disgrace, and feel like a fairy.
Looking from a distance, the Black Dragon Mountain Range looks like a giant dragon about to take off. Legend has it that thousands of years ago, a giant black dragon descended from the sky and transformed into the Black Dragon Mountains that spread thousands of miles. This is also the origin of the name of the Black Dragon Mountains.
On the Tianying Peak of the Black Dragon Mountain Range, a low hill over a hundred feet high. I saw a boy in his teens wearing a short blue shirt, with bare arms and a relaxed buttocks, lifting a blue boulder about the size of an abbot and weighing a hundred kilograms, beating his body.
The peach blossoms that have just bloomed are still hanging on the branches. The young man in green shirt was in the peach forest, with his head raised, his crotch raised, his chest tight and his back tight, and he was doing a set of boxing skills in a precise manner. I saw the boulder weighing hundreds of kilograms, moving back and forth on his body as his moves changed, and the stone moved with it as if it were one body.
The young man's movements were sometimes like a ferocious lion fighting a rabbit and a dragon going out to sea, sometimes like a poisonous snake spitting out letters and a golden rooster becoming independent. Only the shapes of lions, lins, snakes, chickens, dragons, phoenixes, bears, and monkeys slowly evolved in his hands, and his movements seemed to be capable of advancing and retreating, transforming and regenerating, combining the virtual and the real, and the changes were endless.
I saw that the young man's moves were getting faster and faster, making it difficult to tell which was a person and which was a bluestone. Gradually, as the young man's figure danced, a group of green shadows was seen, bringing with it gusts of hot wind. Suddenly, the branches that had just bloomed began to squeak non-stop, shaking off the few peach pistils one by one.
Ye Zhong raised his head and glanced at the sky filled with clouds, and said silently in his heart: "The time has come, it's time to return to the castle, otherwise mother should be anxious!".
I recall that when I was doing breakthrough training, I practiced so selflessly that I lost track of time. In the end, her mother, Shen Yan, mobilized everyone in the fort to search for her at Tianying Peak. She was punished by her furious mother and was locked up in a closed cell for a month. While making Ye Chong warm his heart, he was also frightened. From then on, Ye Chong never dared to return to the castle on time. Ye Chong was not only afraid that his mother would be worried, but also afraid that his mother would be angry.
I saw Ye Zhong taking a strange step, but in a blink of an eye, he was a hundred meters away. Immediately, a green shadow was seen, flickering in the mountain forest, bringing up a series of blue afterimages like the wind.
Looking at the increasingly clear vermilion gate, Ye Zhong murmured in a low voice: "This 'Eight-Step Cicada' is considered a great success, but it has been unable to form a 'Yuan Wheel' and become a 'Warrior'. I don't know how long it will take to wait?".
Ye Chong had a secret that only he knew. He was not from this world. Ye Chong lived on a blue planet called "Earth" in his previous life, and was a descendant of the Bagua Sect in ancient China.
In the world where Ye Zhong lived in his previous life, martial arts declined and techniques were lost and out of touch. The legendary innate warrior has long since become extinct.
Although Ye Chong himself can be called a genius in martial arts, he is still in the realm of acquired skills. After reviewing fragments of ancient books, Ye Chong in his previous life made a bold conjecture.
In ancient times, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth was rich. Warriors first polished themselves, and then used the spiritual energy of heaven and earth for their own use, breaking through the shackles of the human body, breaking the laws of heaven and earth, becoming land gods, and ascending in the daytime.
But later on, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth gradually disappeared and became very thin, making it difficult for warriors to absorb it. Since Zhang Sanfeng, the real person who manifested through micro-manifestation, there has been no land immortal who can ascend in the daytime. In modern times, with the rapid development of civilization and the explosive growth of population, the aura of heaven and earth finally dissipated, and in the end even the innate warriors became extinct.
Out of the warrior's obsession to pursue the peak of martial arts, Ye Zhong in his previous life, after reaching the peak of acquired cultivation at the age of thirty, tried every possible means to break through to the legendary innate realm. He even did not hesitate to join the national department and collect ancient spiritual practice secrets, hoping to make a breakthrough.
However, contrary to expectations, during a mission, he was betrayed by a traitor, besieged by the enemy, and eventually died in a foreign land and returned to another world. Reborn in this Yuanwu Continent, he was born into a family named "Tianying Castle". Fortunately, Tian Jian was pitiful, and he was reborn in the spiritually rich Yuanwu Continent, where he could continue to pursue the elusive and supreme path of martial arts.
"Master Zhong, you are back!" Two young men in black robes bowed down and said respectfully to Ye Zhong.
Hearing this, Ye Chong smiled and nodded, then stepped through the door.
"Shen Fu, Master Zhong is really hardworking! If you practice diligently every day, I'm afraid you will be able to become a warrior soon!"
Then he heard an affirmative voice and replied with admiration: "Of course, Master Zhong practiced martial arts at the age of five, practiced body training at the age of eight, and practiced muscle training at the age of ten. He has already opened his eight meridians at the age of twelve. As long as he forms the 'Yuan Wheel', he can become a 'warrior'. Master Zhong is destined to become a famous figure in the dynasty, and he is not comparable to you and me!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the boy looked at Ye Chong's retreating figure with envy.
The boy opposite nodded when he heard this, and replied with a happy face: "Yes! When the eldest young master was here, I didn't see any young master Zhong working so hard. Moreover, the eldest young master only opened the eight meridians when he was thirteen years old, which was a whole year later than young master Zhong. The eldest young master can enter Tianyuan Mansion to practice at the age of fifteen, and young master Zhong will certainly be able to do the same. Our Tianying Castle looks like it will be famous for a while!"
"I think you are thinking about the reward from the castle master! You are also a naughty kid. You actually used the reward from the eldest young master to enter Tianyuan Mansion to get married and marry a beautiful woman. You also gave birth to a fat boy this year, but I am so jealous of you.
